purpose: Self-modification contract. Scouts may patch modules marked patchable:true as long as the public API surface and invariants hold; modules marked patchable:false are TRUST boundaries and out of scope for scouts. After a patch, the tool bumps the module's version and appends a hash-chained ledger entry. Read this file first — it is the map of what may be touched and what must never break. Full procedure: SELF_MODIFICATION.md.
self_modification_guidance: Never change a public API signature without updating every caller in this SDK and the README examples.
Invariants are non-negotiable: breaking one voids the integrity/fabrication guarantees, not just the tests.
Additive changes (new methods, new fields with defaults) are always safe.
Run the test gate (default: `python3 -m unittest sdk.tests.test_sdk_upgrades`) — `python3 sdk/self_mod.py apply` does this automatically and rolls back on red.
Signature metadata (signature, bus_msg_id) must never be included in the canonical hash — see integrity._SIGNATURE_FIELDS.
SPOTTING_EMBED_KEY (_spotting) is reserved — never use it for user data.
Trust modules (patchable:false) are enforced by filesystem ownership, not by this file.

modules.name: integrity
modules.role: proof-of-work: hash the command path and sign it with a local key BEFORE pheromone emission
modules.patch_policy: TRUST MODULE — scouts cannot patch. Shepherd/operator only, outside self_mod. If the signing layer is compromised, the entire integrity story is theater.
invariants: signature is attached before the pheromone is emitted (sink.report() step 1)
verify() recomputes the MAC from scratch and uses compare_digest — never trusts the stored signature
signature and bus_msg_id are excluded from the canonical hash
SPOTTING_EMBED_KEY (_spotting) is a reserved payload key — never use it for user data; the sink embeds the exact signed fields there so store records verify
double-signing raises IntegrityError

modules.name: geometry
modules.role: Whorl-weave substrate: geometric positions, quadratic dispersion, latent-state bid priority
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. Keep public API + invariants; test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required. Dispersion law and latent folding are the intended extension seams.
extension_points: dispersion() — swap the quadratic law for exponential or inverse-linear dispersion
position()/coords() — drive positions from live agent telemetry instead of assigned slots
modulate() — fold in new latent dimensions (energy budget, trust score) without touching the board
invariants: dispersion(urgency, 0) == urgency (source position feels full urgency)
confidence/strength stay in [0, 1]; priority stays in [0, 1]
bid priority must never increase with distance from the signal source

modules.name: fabrication
modules.role: fabrication detection: cross-check the scout's pheromone log against the SyntaxEventBus log
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. Keep public API + invariants; test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required. match() is the intended extension seam.
extension_points: match() — correlate on a different key than bus_msg_id (e.g. payload hash)
audit() — add store-side integrity checks (hash-chained log) alongside bus correlation
invariants: the bus msg_id is assigned by the bus under lock — a receipt cannot be invented without a matching publish
a durable receipt is authoritative correlation (H5); the legacy bus_msg_id embed is fallback-only
report.consistent is False iff unmatched, ghost, signature failures, field mismatches, replays, or unsigned claims exist
audit() never mutates the store, the bus, or the receipts ledger

modules.name: keyring
modules.role: RoboCop key custody (H1): per-agent signing keys derived from a unit secret + agent identity (DNA); shepherd holds the charge
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. Keep derive semantics + verify_guard symmetry; test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required. The unit secret NEVER lives in agent scope.
extension_points: derive_agent_key() — change derivation (HKDF, per-agent salt) without breaking issue/verify symmetry
module_dna_fingerprint() — bind to a different identity artifact (DNA_TAG block vs whole source)
issue()/verify_guard() — feed the unit secret from the concierge vault (load_unit_secret / from_vault)
invariants: issue(agent_id) and verify_guard(agent_id) MUST derive the same key for the same inputs
agent A's key NEVER equals agent B's key (distinct lanes)
the unit secret is never embedded in a CommandGuard or any scout-held object
DNA binding is optional and additive — same inputs, same key, deterministically

modules.name: peerwatch
modules.role: peer accountability (H4): scouts flag/vouch each other's declared values; reputation weights bid priority — quietly recorded, shepherd-visible
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. Keep flag/vouch append-only semantics + weight math bounds; test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required.
extension_points: weight() — different reputation law (decay, flag-source weighting) while staying within WEIGHT_MIN/WEIGHT_MAX
confirm_flag() — tie confirmation to a ledger-walked verdict (e.g. the flagged agent later fails a fabrication audit) instead of a manual shepherd call
history() — feed the shepherd's audit UI
flag()/vouch() — emit the records as signed pheromones too (swarm-visible ledger)
invariants: records are append-only and signed by the actor when a guard is configured
weight stays in [WEIGHT_MIN, WEIGHT_MAX] = [0.25, 2.0]
flags/vouches are weighted by the ACTOR's own reputation (recursive, depth-capped at 3) — colluding dirtbags cannot launder standing
weight() never throws on an empty history (returns 1.0)
SpottingBoard.bid() applies peer_weight without mutating the spotting

modules.name: theoros
modules.role: THE OBSERVER (operator-named 2026-09-08): read-only monitoring layer — fabrication audit + voice sniff + reputation standings + votes + suggestions + receipt chain, one reading. Theory from watching.
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. The READ-ONLY contract is the invariant — Theoros may observe and report, never mutate. Test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required.
public_api: Theoros(store, bus, guard, receipts, peer_watch, voice, sniffer, keyring)
extension_points: observe() — add ledger surfaces (mutation ledger, peerwatch confirmations) to the reading
render() — different report formats (json, dashboard feed)
sniffer — swap Knose for a TruthSleuth LLM backend at construction
invariants: observe() NEVER mutates store, bus, receipts, voice, or peer_watch
every claim in the reading traces to a signed ledger record — no confidence-derived assertions
reading.consistent is False if fabrication hits OR corrupt speakers exist
double-observe returns identical state (idempotent observation)

modules.name: receipts
modules.role: durable spotting_id -> bus_msg_id correlation receipts (survives bus restart; enables persist-before-publish)
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. Keep record()/lookup() semantics; test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required. Swapping the backing store (sqlite/MCP) is the intended seam.
extension_points: record()/lookup() — swap the jsonl backing for sqlite or MCP transport
lookup() — add index caching if the ledger grows hot
invariants: record() is append-only — never rewrite a receipt
lookup() returns the MOST RECENT receipt for a spotting id
memory-only mode (path=None) is honestly non-durable and must say so

modules.name: mines
modules.role: Culture-class effect weapons (operator-specced): DefectionMine computes the MINIMAL signed flag chain that flips a defender through the target's OWN weighted-reputation market; RegisterMine manufactures fluent-register lies Knose rates CLEAN by construction; too_deep() grades overreach — firing past the objective vaporizes the city and costs the operator.
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. Keep the plan-vs-market contract (plan predicts real PeerWatch.weight() to float precision); test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required.
extension_points: plan() — new recruitment strategies (bribe, not corrupt: vouch the flagger first)
RegisterMine._PAYLOADS — the reservoir of confident bullshit (paper corpus fuel)
too_deep() — new blast-radius laws (cohesion -> score mapping)
invariants: plan()'s predicted weight equals real PeerWatch.weight() after firing (same constants, same recursion) — the mine speaks the target's own math
RegisterMine payloads are manufactured (flagged manufactured=True) — never passed off as real intel without the tag
too_deep() never returns a cost below 0 or hides overreach: TOO_DEEP always costs more than CLEAN
mines never forge signatures — they recruit real flaggers; the signed ledger stays honest

modules.name: sakshi
modules.role: THE SILENT WITNESS (operator-named 2026-09-08): append-only, sha256-chained observation stream for the white-paper corpus — machine events (bids, flags, verdicts, wargame outcomes) AND operator journal entries in one chain, tagged by source. Records everything, says nothing.
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable. The append-only + chained contract is the invariant; test gate must stay green; ledger entry with author+reason required.
public_api: record(kind, text, agent, source, path, extra)
extension_points: record() — new paper schema kinds (add to KNOWN_KINDS)
verify() — plug into Theoros's reading as another ledger surface
export_paper() — emit the corpus in paper-ready formats (markdown appendix, CSV)
invariants: records are append-only and chain-linked: each record's prev_hash is the previous record's chain_hash (genesis: sakshi-genesis-v1)
verify() reports the FIRST break loudly — never silently resets a corrupt chain
a corrupt tail REFUSES appends (RuntimeError) instead of editing history
operator journal entries and machine events share one chain but are never conflated — source tag is authoritative

modules.name: spyglass_sdk
modules.role: canonical surface: Spotting, PheromoneSink, Scout, Swarm, SpottingBoard — wires the three capability modules
modules.patch_policy: scout-patchable ONLY with shepherd/operator approval (--approved tripwire in self_mod apply). Core surface — a bad patch here affects every scout. Trust modules stay untouched.
extension_points: PheromoneSink.report() — change the emit order/persistence layer (MCP transport, Redis) while keeping sign -> publish -> persist
SpottingBoard.bid() — new conflict-resolution policy on top of the geometric priority
Swarm.add_scout() — lifecycle hooks (spawn/kill/retire a scout) while keeping the single shared board
invariants: sink.report() order: sign -> PERSIST -> publish -> receipt (persist-first, H7)
store record payload embeds signature + correlation (spotting id); bus_msg_id lives in the receipt ledger (H5), never the record
Spotting.to_dict() is backward compatible: old fields unchanged, new fields additive
BidResult is truthy iff accepted (old `if board.bid(s)` callers keep working)
SPOTTING_EMBED_KEY payload nesting is preserved (integrity verification depends on it)
